title: Hub: require a room policy by default; policy-less open rooms only when the operator enables them
description: Found 2026-11-18 (verify claim 13). decision mimid-1wgh.52: a room without base_room_policy is an open room and every participant gets every capability (hub/policy.rs ~L97-103); the hub accepts such rooms unless require_room_policy = true. That's spec-allowed (room policy is SHOULD) but means kick/ban/role changes are open to all in such rooms. Decide: keep (document prominently, it's what other implementations without policy send), flip the default of require_room_policy, or give open rooms a narrower default; needs Mark's call (label human).
